attributes.probed_form: The three little-endian container readers were DEFINED at file top (lines 451-479) under `#pragma dont_inline on` / `#pragma dont_inline off`. Replaced that block with three prototypes -- `u16 ReadU16LE(u8* p); u32 ReadU32LE(u8* p); u32 ReadF32LE(u8* p);` -- and moved the three bodies verbatim to file end, after the last `#pragma cplusplus off` and before the closing `} /* extern "C" */`. The dont_inline pragma pair was DELETED, not moved: with the definitions at file end no caller can see a body, so nothing can be auto-inlined and the pragma is redundant.
